purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Specimen Labeling Verification' screen within workflow WF_005.
postconditions: All required fields on 'Specimen Labeling Verification' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm the label was printed and applied at the patient's bedside, not in advance
Confirm two patient identifiers on the label match the patient's wristband
common_errors: Label printed prior to collection rather than at bedside
Identifier mismatch between label and wristband

Patient Identifiers on Label input control
